main_html:
TRAINING PAGE

VA Training Sandbox

Training environment — not production. Use this hub to learn the repo, the page types, the sponsor model, and the validation workflow before touching canonical packs.

Open public training site: local-guides-generator.pages.dev

First step

Before you ask an LLM anything, upload the Global Repository Operations Manual and the Listings Master Index. Then tell the LLM whether you are in training mode or real repo mode.

LLM prompts to copy

Training mode: I uploaded the Global Repository Operations Manual and the Listings Master Index. Use them as governing documents. I am working in the starter training pack. Explain the workflow step by step and tell me what to verify after each change.

Real repo mode: I uploaded the Global Repository Operations Manual and the Listings Master Index. Use them as governing documents. I am working in the real Local Guides Generator repo. Modify existing files only, validate before claiming anything is done, and show exact changed files.

Practice flows

Add a fake city

Edit data/training/cities.json, rebuild the starter pack, and confirm the city and state pages render.

Add a fake sponsor

Edit data/training/sponsorships.json, rebuild the starter pack, and confirm the sponsor spotlight appears on the matching training city page.

Audit a page

Open the copied training surfaces, compare them with docs and runtime rules, and note any drift.
